amber-pulse.$description: Amber Pulse — Yellow supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

lime-signal.$description: Lime Signal — Green supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis.

lavender-wash.$description: Lavender Wash — Text-to-audio feature panel background — large full-bleed section tint

mustard-field.$description: Mustard Field — Audio-to-audio feature panel background — full-bleed section tint

sage-mist.$description: Sage Mist — Sound effects feature panel background — full-bleed section tint

khaki-paper.$description: Khaki Paper — Secondary panel tint, hero left-column background — warm beige sitting one step darker than the main cream canvas

warm-canvas.$description: Warm Canvas — Page background, dominant cream surface — every section and most cards sit on this tone

pure-paper.$description: Pure Paper — Card surfaces, track cards, elevated panels — the only true white in the system

pale-mist.$description: Pale Mist — Cool light-gray structural tone for subtle UI layers beneath the warm cream

ink-stone.$description: Ink Stone — Secondary text, dark app-interface surfaces, filled toggle states — near-black with a slight warm cast

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Dark supporting neutral for text, icons, and strong contrast. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

ash.$description: Ash — Muted body text, helper text, metadata — mid-gray for tertiary information

inter.$description: All text — headlines commit to weight 700 (bold), never 500 or 600; the two-weight commitment is a signature choice that gives the interface a confident, opinionated voice without needing a display face
